item.description: State Lawmakers Step In to Support Minority-Serving Institutions Sara Weissman Mon, 03/09/2026 - 03:00 AM Since the Education Department axed funding to MSIs last fall, state policymakers have proposed bills to recognize and sustain such colleges and universities moving forward. item.title: Students ‘Doing OK’ Can Still Be at Risk
item.description: Students ‘Doing OK’ Can Still Be at Risk Joshua.Bay Mon, 03/09/2026 - 03:00 AM A TimelyCare survey finds academically stable students can struggle quietly, highlighting the need for proactive check-ins and support. Byline(s) Joshua Bay

item.title: Georgia to Launch Need-Based DREAMS Scholarship
item.description: Georgia to Launch Need-Based DREAMS Scholarship Johanna Alonso Mon, 03/09/2026 - 03:00 AM For years, the state’s main source of funds for college students was its merit-based HOPE Scholarship. Now, lawmakers are allocating $325 million to a need-based program in hopes it will encourage students to study in the state. Byline(s) Johanna Alonso

item.title: Pressure Mounts on Bard President
item.description: Pressure Mounts on Bard President Emma Whitford Mon, 03/09/2026 - 03:00 AM The Faculty Senate is calling for the creation of a fund equivalent to Jeffrey Epstein’s total donations to the college, to be spent on initiatives concerning sexual violence. Byline(s) Emma Whitford
